mapper.select: select * from biz_iot_experiment where experiment_id = #{experimentId}
select * from biz_iot_experiment where lesson_id = #{lessonId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = '0' order by experiment_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_iot_experiment (lesson_id, dept_id, activity_code, title, description, topic_prefix, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{lessonId}, #{deptId}, #{activityCode}, #{title}, #{description}, #{topicPrefix}, '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from biz_iot_message where experiment_id in (select experiment_id from biz_iot_experiment where lesson_id = #{lessonId})
delete from biz_iot_event where experiment_id in (select experiment_id from biz_iot_experiment where lesson_id = #{lessonId})
delete from biz_iot_group_student where experiment_id in (select experiment_id from biz_iot_experiment where lesson_id = #{lessonId})
delete from biz_iot_device where group_id in (select group_id from biz_iot_group where experiment_id in (select experiment_id from biz_iot_experiment where lesson_id = #{lessonId}))
delete from biz_iot_group where experiment_id in (select experiment_id from biz_iot_experiment where lesson_id = #{lessonId})
delete from biz_iot_class_config where experiment_id in (select experiment_id from biz_iot_experiment where lesson_id = #{lessonId})
mapper.select: select c.*, (select count(*) from biz_iot_group_student gs where gs.experiment_id = c.experiment_id and gs.group_id in (select g.group_id from biz_iot_group g where g.experiment_id = c.experiment_id and g.entry_year = c.entry_year and g.class_code = c.class_code)) as student_count, (select count(*) from biz_iot_group g where g.experiment_id = c.experiment_id and g.entry_year = c.entry_year and g.class_code = c.class_code and g.status = '0') as group_count from biz_iot_class_config c where c.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and c.entry_year = #{entryYear} and c.class_code = #{classCode}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_iot_class_config (experiment_id, dept_id, entry_year, class_code, group_size, mqtt_username, passcode_ciphertext, passcode_hash, passcode_version, group_version, passcode_updated_at, grouped_at, broker_sync_status, broker_synced_at, broker_sync_error, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{experimentId}, #{deptId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, #{groupSize}, #{mqttUsername}, #{passcodeCiphertext}, #{passcodeHash}, #{passcodeVersion}, #{groupVersion}, #{passcodeUpdatedAt}, #{groupedAt}, #{brokerSyncStatus}, #{brokerSyncedAt}, #{brokerSyncError}, '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update biz_iot_class_config set group_size = #{groupSize}, mqtt_username = #{mqttUsername}, passcode_ciphertext = #{passcodeCiphertext}, passcode_hash = #{passcodeHash}, passcode_version = #{passcodeVersion}, group_version = #{groupVersion}, passcode_updated_at = #{passcodeUpdatedAt}, grouped_at = #{groupedAt}, broker_sync_status = #{brokerSyncStatus}, broker_synced_at = #{brokerSyncedAt}, broker_sync_error = #{brokerSyncError}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where config_id = #{configId}
mapper.select: select distinct a.entry_year as entryYear, a.class_code as classCode, a.dept_id as deptId, concat(a.entry_year, '级', a.class_code, '班') as className from biz_lesson_assignment a where a.lesson_id = #{lessonId} and a.dept_id = #{deptId} order by a.entry_year desc, cast(a.class_code as unsigned) asc, a.class_code asc

select s.student_id as studentId, s.user_id as userId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.entry_year as entryYear, s.class_code as classCode, u.nick_name as studentName from biz_student s inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id where u.dept_id = #{deptId} and s.entry_year = #{entryYear} and s.class_code = #{classCode} and u.del_flag = '0' order by cast(s.student_no as unsigned) asc, s.student_no asc

select g.*, count(distinct d.device_id) as device_count, count(distinct gs.group_student_id) as student_count, max(case when g.last_seen_at is not null then g.last_seen_at else d.last_seen_at end) as last_seen_at from biz_iot_group g left join biz_iot_device d on d.group_id = g.group_id and d.status = '0' left join biz_iot_group_student gs on gs.group_id = g.group_id where g.group_id = #{groupId} group by g.group_id

select g.*, count(distinct d.device_id) as device_count, count(distinct gs.group_student_id) as student_count, max(case when g.last_seen_at is not null then g.last_seen_at else d.last_seen_at end) as last_seen_at from biz_iot_group g left join biz_iot_device d on d.group_id = g.group_id and d.status = '0' left join biz_iot_group_student gs on gs.group_id = g.group_id where g.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and g.status = '0' group by g.group_id order by g.entry_year desc, cast(g.class_code as unsigned) asc, g.class_code asc, g.group_no asc, g.group_code asc

select g.*, count(distinct d.device_id) as device_count, count(distinct gs.group_student_id) as student_count, max(case when g.last_seen_at is not null then g.last_seen_at else d.last_seen_at end) as last_seen_at from biz_iot_group g left join biz_iot_device d on d.group_id = g.group_id and d.status = '0' left join biz_iot_group_student gs on gs.group_id = g.group_id where g.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and g.entry_year = #{entryYear} and g.class_code = #{classCode} and g.status = '0' group by g.group_id order by g.group_no asc, g.group_code asc

select g.*, count(distinct d.device_id) as device_count, count(distinct gs.group_student_id) as student_count, max(case when g.last_seen_at is not null then g.last_seen_at else d.last_seen_at end) as last_seen_at from biz_iot_group g join biz_teacher_class tc on tc.entry_year = g.entry_year and tc.class_code = g.class_code left join biz_iot_device d on d.group_id = g.group_id and d.status = '0' left join biz_iot_group_student gs on gs.group_id = g.group_id where g.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and g.status = '0' and tc.user_id = #{userId} and tc.dept_id = #{deptId} group by g.group_id order by g.entry_year desc, cast(g.class_code as unsigned) asc, g.class_code asc, g.group_no asc, g.group_code asc
select g.* from biz_iot_group g where (g.topic = #{topic} or #{topic} like concat(g.topic, '/%')) and g.status = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_iot_group (experiment_id, entry_year, class_code, group_code, group_no, group_name, topic, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{experimentId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, #{groupCode}, #{groupNo}, #{groupName}, #{topic}, '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from biz_iot_group where experiment_id = #{experimentId} and entry_year = #{entryYear} and class_code = #{classCode}
mapper.update: update biz_iot_group set last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, update_time = now() where group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.select: select gs.* from biz_iot_group_student gs join biz_iot_group g on g.group_id = gs.group_id where gs.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and g.entry_year = #{entryYear} and g.class_code = #{classCode} order by g.group_no asc, gs.sort_order asc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_iot_group_student (group_id, experiment_id, student_id, student_no, student_name, sort_order, create_time) values (#{groupId}, #{experimentId}, #{studentId}, #{studentNo}, #{studentName}, #{sortOrder}, now())
mapper.select: select d.*, g.experiment_id, case when g.topic is not null then concat(g.topic, '/device', d.device_code, '/data') else concat(e.topic_prefix, '/', g.entry_year, '_', g.class_code, '/', e.activity_code, '/', g.group_code, '/', d.device_code, '/data') end as topic from biz_iot_device d join biz_iot_group g on g.group_id = d.group_id join biz_iot_experiment e on e.experiment_id = g.experiment_id where d.device_id = #{deviceId}

select d.*, g.experiment_id, case when g.topic is not null then concat(g.topic, '/device', d.device_code, '/data') else concat(e.topic_prefix, '/', g.entry_year, '_', g.class_code, '/', e.activity_code, '/', g.group_code, '/', d.device_code, '/data') end as topic from biz_iot_device d join biz_iot_group g on g.group_id = d.group_id join biz_iot_experiment e on e.experiment_id = g.experiment_id where d.group_id = #{groupId} and d.status = '0' order by d.device_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_iot_device (group_id, device_code, device_name, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{groupId}, #{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update biz_iot_device set broker_username = #{brokerUsername}, credential_hash = #{credentialHash}, credential_expires_at = #{credentialExpiresAt}, update_time = now() where device_id = #{deviceId}
update biz_iot_device set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.select: select d.*, g.experiment_id, case when g.topic is not null then g.topic else concat(e.topic_prefix, '/', g.entry_year, '_', g.class_code, '/', e.activity_code, '/', g.group_code, '/', d.device_code, '/data') end as topic from biz_iot_device d join biz_iot_group g on g.group_id = d.group_id join biz_iot_experiment e on e.experiment_id = g.experiment_id where d.status = '0' and d.credential_expires_at is not null and d.credential_expires_at <= #{now}
mapper.update: update biz_iot_device set last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, update_time = now() where device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_iot_group g join biz_iot_experiment e on e.experiment_id = g.experiment_id join biz_teacher_class tc on tc.dept_id = e.dept_id and tc.entry_year = g.entry_year and tc.class_code = g.class_code where g.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and tc.user_id = #{userId} and tc.dept_id = #{deptId}
select count(*) from biz_teacher_class tc where tc.user_id = #{userId} and tc.dept_id = #{deptId} and tc.entry_year = #{entryYear} and tc.class_code = #{classCode}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_iot_message (experiment_id, group_id, device_id, topic, payload_type, payload_text, payload_number, source_ip, qos, retained, received_at) values (#{experimentId}, #{groupId}, #{deviceId}, #{topic}, #{payloadType}, #{payloadText}, #{payloadNumber}, #{sourceIp}, #{qos}, #{retained}, #{receivedAt})
mapper.select: select m.*, g.group_code, coalesce(d.device_code, 'data') as device_code from biz_iot_message m join biz_iot_group g on g.group_id = m.group_id left join biz_iot_device d on d.device_id = m.device_id where m.experiment_id = #{experimentId} order by m.received_at desc limit #{limit}

select m.*, g.group_code, coalesce(d.device_code, 'data') as device_code from biz_iot_message m join biz_iot_group g on g.group_id = m.group_id left join biz_iot_device d on d.device_id = m.device_id where m.group_id = #{groupId} order by m.received_at desc limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: join biz_iot_group g on g.group_id = m.group_id left join biz_iot_device d on d.device_id = m.device_id
mapper.select:
select m.*, g.group_code, coalesce(d.device_code, 'data') as device_code from biz_iot_message m
order by m.received_at desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(*) from biz_iot_message m

select g.group_id as groupId, g.group_code as groupCode, g.group_name as groupName, count(m.message_id) as messageCount, max(m.received_at) as lastReceivedAt, (select m2.payload_type from biz_iot_message m2 where m2.group_id = g.group_id order by m2.received_at desc, m2.message_id desc limit 1) as lastPayloadType, (select coalesce(m2.payload_text, cast(m2.payload_number as char), '') from biz_iot_message m2 where m2.group_id = g.group_id order by m2.received_at desc, m2.message_id desc limit 1) as lastPayload from biz_iot_group g left join biz_iot_message m on m.group_id = g.group_id where g.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and g.entry_year = #{entryYear} and g.class_code = #{classCode} and g.status = '0' group by g.group_id, g.group_code, g.group_name order by g.group_no asc, g.group_code asc

select g.group_id as groupId, g.group_code as groupCode, g.group_name as groupName, count(m.message_id) as messageCount, max(m.received_at) as lastReceivedAt, (select m2.payload_type from biz_iot_message m2 where m2.group_id = g.group_id order by m2.received_at desc, m2.message_id desc limit 1) as lastPayloadType, (select coalesce(m2.payload_text, cast(m2.payload_number as char), '') from biz_iot_message m2 where m2.group_id = g.group_id order by m2.received_at desc, m2.message_id desc limit 1) as lastPayload from biz_iot_group g join biz_teacher_class tc on tc.entry_year = g.entry_year and tc.class_code = g.class_code left join biz_iot_message m on m.group_id = g.group_id where g.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and g.entry_year = #{entryYear} and g.class_code = #{classCode} and g.status = '0' and tc.user_id = #{userId} and tc.dept_id = #{deptId} group by g.group_id, g.group_code, g.group_name order by g.group_no asc, g.group_code asc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_iot_event (experiment_id, group_id, device_id, event_type, diagnostic_stage, detail, payload_digest, occurred_at) values (#{experimentId}, #{groupId}, #{deviceId}, #{eventType}, #{diagnosticStage}, #{detail}, #{payloadDigest}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: select * from biz_iot_event where experiment_id = #{experimentId} order by occurred_at desc limit #{limit}
